description: Property Hazard & Site Risk Report — Before an agent recommends, underwrites or screens a US property, reads free public federal hazard data for a street address or lat/lon: Census geocode, FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer flood zone, SFHA status and base flood elevation, USGS ASCE 7-22 seismic design values, FEMA National Risk Index tract ratings (wildfire, hurricane, tornado and more), OpenFEMA county disaster declarations for 10 y

address.description: US street address with city and state or ZIP, e.g. 1111 Lincoln Rd, Miami Beach, FL 33139. Give this or lat with lon.

intended_use.description: Optional. Reweights the score: residential counts environmental proximity 1.5x, industrial 0.5x, development counts flood and seismic 1.5x.

lat.description: Latitude in WGS84 degrees; give with lon instead of address.

lon.description: Longitude in WGS84 degrees; give with lat.

name: property-risk
